blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewee: Jon Hendricks (September 16, 1921 – November 22, 2017) and, on August 18, his wife Judith Interviewer: James Zimmerman with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 95 pp.
Today is August 17th. We’re in Washington, D.C., at the National Portrait Galley. Today we’re interviewing Mr. Jon Hendricks, composer, lyricist, playwright, singer: the poet laureate of jazz. Jon.
Would you give us your full name, the birth place, and share with us your familial history.
